description: Infrastructures de recharges pour véhicules électriques (IRVE) is a dataset listed in COEUR DE FRANCE open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Etalab. 1. Objet du jeu de données Ce jeu de données décrit les infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques (IRVE) situées dans le périmètre de la Communauté de communes Cœur de France. Il recense chaque point de charge disponible, avec ses caractéristiques techniques, son opérateur, sa localisation et son état. 2. Coverage: Cœur de France (Cher). The portal files it under Aménagement de l'espace. Its keywords are Recharge électrique, EPCI, Mobilité. The portal shows 203 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cc-coeurdefrance-fr-portal.
